reasoning: Rewriting gives x²+z²=(2/5)y². Sections at fixed nonzero y are circles with radius proportional to |y|, giving a double cone with vertex at the origin and axis along the y-axis. A circular cone is a special case of an elliptic cone, so choice d is correct. No Math Academy answer or grade for this question is captured; the worked example concerns a different surface.
